mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 202.0, it signals high inflation, triggering monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 202.0, 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) and declining employment (PAYEMS < 135000) indicates labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.5 AND PAYEMS < 135000, 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate overbought conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the 'late-cycle expansion' regime, 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The level of housing starts (HOUST) is a leading indicator of economic health; higher HOUST values correlate with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals industrial sector contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the interaction of RSAFS and HOUST and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL high), increased borrowing costs and reduced liquidity lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the 'monetary tightening cycle' regime, 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.
